tasks.title: Confirm vision & objectives with client group
tasks.details: Facilitated session producing a one-page vision the group has formally adopted.

tasks.title: Choose & register legal form (CLT/CBS/co-op)
tasks.details: Compare structures with the group and register the chosen entity.

tasks.title: Adopt constitution & policies
tasks.details: Model rules tailored and adopted; core policies (conflicts, safeguarding, finance) in place.

tasks.title: Recruit/confirm steering group & roles
tasks.details: Named chair, secretary, treasurer and leads with agreed terms of reference.

tasks.title: Skills audit & training plan
tasks.details: Map member skills against what the project needs; book training for gaps.

tasks.title: Open bank account, arrange insurances
tasks.details: Community account opened; trustee indemnity and public liability cover bound.

tasks.title: Membership drive & register
tasks.details: Recruit members per the rules; maintain the statutory membership register.

tasks.title: Agree decision-making & meeting cadence
tasks.details: Decision log started; meeting rhythm and quorum agreed with the group.

tasks.title: Define site requirements brief
tasks.details: Homes, tenure mix, access and services criteria the site must meet.

tasks.title: Site search & land audit
tasks.details: Systematic sweep of council land, estates and market opportunities against the brief.

tasks.title: Landowner approach & negotiation
tasks.details: Open discussions with the preferred site's owner.

tasks.title: Commission housing needs survey
tasks.details: Independent survey evidencing local need for the homes proposed.

tasks.title: Desktop planning-policy review
tasks.details: Local plan, allocations and constraints check for the shortlisted site.

tasks.title: Development appraisal v1
tasks.details: First-pass viability: costs, values, funding assumptions.

tasks.title: Title & legal due diligence
tasks.details: Title, covenants, easements and rights of way checked by solicitors.

tasks.title: Utilities & access desk study
tasks.details: Confirm services capacity and safe access can be achieved.

tasks.title: Contamination Phase 1 desk study
tasks.details: Historic-use review to flag remediation risk early.

tasks.title: Pre-application submission
tasks.details: Formal pre-app to the LPA with concept sketch and supporting evidence.

tasks.title: Assess pre-app response
tasks.details: Digest officer feedback; agree design and evidence changes needed.

tasks.title: Heads of terms / option agreement
tasks.details: Secure the site under option or conditional contract.

tasks.title: Appoint architect/design team
tasks.details: Competitive selection; appointment on agreed scope and fee.

tasks.title: Appoint QS/cost consultant
tasks.details: Cost control from concept stage onwards.

tasks.title: Appoint principal designer (CDM)
tasks.details: CDM 2015 duty holder appointed in writing.

tasks.title: Community co-design rounds
tasks.details: Structured workshops feeding member priorities into the design.

tasks.title: Concept design sign-off (RIBA 2)
tasks.details: Group formally approves the concept before spatial coordination.

tasks.title: Spatial coordination (RIBA 3)
tasks.details: Coordinated design frozen ahead of the planning application.

tasks.title: BNG assessment & Gain Plan
tasks.details: Biodiversity net gain baseline and 10% gain plan prepared.

tasks.title: Fire statement prepared
tasks.details: Fire safety statement to accompany the planning application.

tasks.title: Submit planning application
tasks.details: Full application validated by the LPA.

tasks.title: S106 heads of terms
tasks.details: Agree obligation heads with the LPA in parallel with determination.

tasks.title: CIL liability & exemption forms
tasks.details: Assume liability and claim any exemptions before commencement.

tasks.title: Planning decision
tasks.details: Determination received; conditions logged into the tracker.

tasks.title: Update appraisal & value engineer
tasks.details: Re-run viability post-consent; agree savings without quality loss.

tasks.title: Funding applications submitted
tasks.details: Bids to the agreed funding stack lodged.

tasks.title: Finance close
tasks.details: All funding agreements signed and conditions precedent met.

tasks.title: Technical design (RIBA 4)
tasks.details: Construction-ready information for tender.

tasks.title: Tender pack issued
tasks.details: Employer's requirements, drawings and preliminaries issued to bidders.

tasks.title: Tender review & contractor selection
tasks.details: Bids levelled and preferred contractor selected.

tasks.title: Building regs full-plans approval
tasks.details: Full plans approved before start on site.

tasks.title: Appoint principal contractor (CDM)
tasks.details: CDM principal contractor duties formally assigned.

tasks.title: F10 notification if notifiable
tasks.details: HSE F10 lodged where the project is notifiable.

tasks.title: Party wall notices (if applicable)
tasks.details: Notices served and awards agreed where works affect neighbours.

tasks.title: Utility connections ordered
tasks.details: Long-lead service connections ordered early.

tasks.title: Pre-start meeting & programme baseline
tasks.details: Contract programme baselined; roles and comms agreed.

tasks.title: Start on site
tasks.details: Possession given and works commenced.

tasks.title: Monthly valuations & certificates (recurring)
tasks.details: Valuations certified monthly through the build.

tasks.title: Monthly funder drawdown claims (recurring)
tasks.details: Claims submitted against certified spend each month.

tasks.title: Variations/change control log maintained
tasks.details: Every instruction priced and logged before commitment.

tasks.title: Discharge pre-commencement conditions
tasks.details: All pre-commencement conditions discharged before works.

tasks.title: Snagging inspection
tasks.details: Joint snagging with contractor ahead of PC.

tasks.title: Practical completion
tasks.details: PC certified; handover begins.

tasks.title: Handover pack & O&M received
tasks.details: As-builts, warranties and O&M manuals received and filed.

tasks.title: Allocations policy adopted
tasks.details: Fair, published policy for allocating the homes.

tasks.title: Advertise & allocate homes
tasks.details: Homes advertised and allocated per the policy.

tasks.title: Leases/tenancies executed
tasks.details: Legal completions for every home.

tasks.title: Residents move in
tasks.details: Phased move-ins complete.

tasks.title: Setup management arrangements (RMC/agent)
tasks.details: Day-to-day management contracted or organised in-house.

tasks.title: Service charge budget set
tasks.details: First-year service charge modelled and communicated.

tasks.title: Defects log & contractor liaison
tasks.details: Defects reported, tracked and closed with the contractor.

tasks.title: End-of-defects inspection
tasks.details: Joint inspection at the end of the rectification period.

tasks.title: Retention release
tasks.details: Final retention certified and released.

tasks.title: Funder final monitoring report
tasks.details: Completion report submitted to funders.

tasks.title: Impact report to board
tasks.details: Outcomes vs objectives reported to the board and members.

tasks.title: Lessons-learned review
tasks.details: Structured review captured for the next scheme.

wales.title: SAB drainage approval
wales.details: Sustainable drainage approval from the SAB before construction.

hrb.title: Confirm BSR gateway strategy
hrb.details: Higher-Risk Building: agree Building Safety Regulator gateway approach.

conservation_area.title: Heritage/conservation officer pre-app engagement
conservation_area.details: Early engagement on heritage impact and design expectations.

risks.description: Site not secured or acquisition falls through
risks.mitigation: Parallel site options; option agreement early; LA relationship

risks.description: Funding gap between stages stalls the project
risks.mitigation: Stage-gated fundraising plan; monitor drawdown vs spend monthly
Pre-app engagement; community support evidence; policy-compliant design
Contingency ≥10%; re-tender options; value engineering rounds

risks.description: Volunteer burnout / loss of key people
risks.mitigation: Succession planning; consultant carries process load; training
Alternative partners identified; avoid single-point dependence

risks.description: Local authority slow decisions / officer turnover
risks.mitigation: Named contacts; escalate via members; build slack into programme
Early engagement; support-letter campaign; address objections in design
Financial checks at tender; retention; warranty & step-in rights
Clear constitution; decision log; independent chair option
